evidence_required: FT-005-AC-003 RED: existing Attempt columns and pending publication have no authenticated report boundary or client post-render sender; GREEN: only four decoded teasers plus full QR visibility emits confirmed with the one-clock non-negative elapsed value, timely failed is best-effort, duplicate same-status is idempotent, conflicting/late reports are rejected and expired pending reads as unconfirmed; decisive comparison: client event trace, HTTP response and stored/effective Attempt state; artifact: disposable DB/API/client evidence under .tasks/TASK-077-T3-FT-005-W2/.
purpose: Complete the single end-to-end confirmation result from successful client rendering to the promo-owned durable/effective display state.
success_outcome: The authenticated display becomes confirmed only after complete render, records the original one-clock elapsed value idempotently, and otherwise preserves failed or derived unconfirmed truth without changing the Promo session.
anti_goals: Do not add or alter an Alembic revision; reuse existing promo_attempts display columns.
Do not add an acknowledgement outbox, scheduler, reliable retry queue or stored unconfirmed transition.
Do not implement display/cooldown timers, phone continuation or change session/ticket/teaser/union/N truth.

forbidden_scope: Database migration history and foreign capability state
QR browser access, phone continuation and purchase navigation
Production credentials, operator/default Attempts or unredacted result artifacts
stop_conditions: The acknowledgement cannot remain a promo-owned transition through the existing Attempt repository.
The report would require a new schema field, scheduler, outbox or mutation of immutable session truth.
Client confirmation cannot be causally placed after four decodes and full QR visibility on the existing monotonic timeline.
Security/state probes cannot be isolated, safely rerun and cleaned without production authority.

constraints: Primary owner is promo; the backend handler authenticates, validates and serializes but never owns the transition.
Reuse face_moment.promo_attempts display_status, display_expires_at, display_reported_at and qr_fully_visible_elapsed_ms through the promo repository.
Use token-derived spa_id and return 404 for foreign/unknown session identity without disclosure.
Use unique task-owned pending/result Attempts and sessions with controlled server/monotonic clocks, safe reruns, decisive state reads and cleanup limited to those fixtures.
invariants: Confirmed is emitted only after all four teaser JPEGs decode and the QR is fully visible.
The first timely terminal report wins; same-status repeat preserves original values and conflict/late report changes nothing.
Unconfirmed is derived after expiry and is never stored or reopened.
No display report mutates the session, QR ticket/times, teaser IDs, complete union or N.
verification_targets: Task-owned client/API/repository probe proves complete-render-only confirmed reporting, timely failed reporting, same-status idempotency, conflicting/late rejection, derived unconfirmed and the original monotonic elapsed value in existing face_moment.promo_attempts columns.
The same probe compares the immutable Promo session before and after every report and proves authenticated principal scope with no session/ticket/expiry/teaser/union/N mutation.
